_comment: AI-Assisted: Claude Code (model: claude-opus-5) - Authored per 004 data-model.md §2.1 and contracts/authored-summary-gates.md §1-§2 (004 task T014), for curation/faction-rules/<faction-id>.json. An OBJECT WRAPPER rather than a bare array, unlike every other authored file here, and the wrapper earns its awkwardness: army_rule_state makes 'this faction genuinely has no army rule' expressible as a curated fact, distinct from 'nobody has curated this faction yet', which is the absence of the file. FR-021 requires that distinction and a bare array cannot carry it. `summary` is authored from the MECHANIC in this data set's own words; machine paraphrase, synonym substitution, and reordering of the publisher's text are policy violations, not shortcuts (FR-024, Principle 4). draft, in_review, and needs_rereview emit FRL-OUTSTANDING (advisory) while WGC_GATE_FACTION_RULES is off and FRL-UNAPPROVED / FRL-NEEDS-REREVIEW (blocking) once it is on -- the gate selects the CODE, never the severity.
title: curation/faction-rules/<faction-id>.json

army_rule_state.description: 'none' means this faction genuinely has no army rule (a mercenary or allied faction) and contributes NOTHING to the coverage denominator -- it is a completed curation decision, not outstanding work. Omitting the file entirely is the third state: not yet curated.

rules.description: Sorted by display_order. Empty or absent when army_rule_state is 'none'.

mechanic_digest.description: A KEYED, TRUNCATED digest (HMAC-SHA256 under a repository-held key, 128 bits) over the hard-normalised mechanic text, computed while that text exists only in ephemeral storage and then discarded. Keying matters: an unkeyed hash of a short, publicly known string can be confirmed by anyone holding the text, whereas a keyed digest can be neither inverted nor used to verify a guess (C6/R8).
